title: Preserve healthy engines on inconclusive checks
body:
## Summary
- Keep a reachable engine attached when its fingerprint RPC is inconclusive, while still replacing positively mismatched builds.
- Debounce unreachable supervision ticks and emit production logs that identify the liveness source and restart evidence.
- Add regression coverage for unresponsive fingerprint RPCs and consecutive-failure restart scheduling.

## Validation
- `bazel build //tools/boss/app-macos:boss_mac_app_lib //tools/boss/app-macos:BossTestsShard3`
- `bazel test //tools/boss/app-macos:BossTestsShard3`
- `bazel build //tools/boss/app-macos:Boss //tools/boss/installer:release`
- `checkleft run`
